name: Simple mana pool
author: Alexandria
summary: Alexandria's own simple mana: a pool of 4 per level plus the casting modifier, spells cost 2 per spell level. Every number is editable under Spells & mana.

assistant.player: This table casts from a mana pool instead of spell slots. To answer what they can still cast, read my_spell_codex for their mana and known spells; a long rest refills the pool.
